titre: Recette moyenne par colis aux Etats-Unis
sous_titre: Marche americain, dollars par colis, 2023 a 2025

2023.texte: With the average revenue per parcel dipping slightly to US$9.09 in 2024 (down from US$9.10 in 2023), pricing pressure is intensifying.

2025.texte: Revenue per parcel increased 2.9% in 2025 to $9.34, up from $9.09 in 2024.
